prompt: How many feet are in $36$ inches? ($12$ in $= 1$ ft)
hint: Inches are being packed into feet, a larger unit. How many inches does it take to make each foot?

hints.text: Inches are being packed into feet, a larger unit. How many inches does it take to make each foot?
Twelve inches make one foot, so find how many twelves are in $36$ by working out $36 \div 12$.
$36 \div 12 = 3$, so there are $3$ feet in $36$ inches.

explanation: Converting from a smaller unit to a larger one means dividing by the number of small units in each large one.
There are $12$ inches in a foot, so compute $36 \div 12$.
Use a multiplication fact to divide: since $12 \times 3 = 36$, the quotient is $3$.
Thirty-six inches are the same length as $3$ feet.
